name: debian-13-xfce
title: Debian 13, Xfce (X11)
hints: Desktop: Debian 13 with Xfce (X11 session), a panel at the top with an Applications menu at the top left.
Apps: the text editor is Mousepad, the file manager is Thunar, the terminal is Xfce Terminal, the web browser is Firefox ESR.
To start an app: use the Applications menu, or press alt+F2, type the app name, press Enter. ctrl+alt+t opens a terminal.
Windows: alt+Tab switches windows, alt+F10 maximizes, alt+F4 closes the focused window.
